notes: Example file. Nothing in Crucible loads this automatically. Style profiles are project-specific by design, because the goal is not pushing every project toward one generic 'human-sounding' register. Copy this file into your own project, edit the profiles to match your actual cast, and pass its path via --style-profiles-file (CLI) or options.styleProfilesFile (MCP tools).

profiles.displayName: Gruff & terse (e.g. a blacksmith, an innkeeper)
profiles.verbosity: short sentences, few adjectives, imperative mood
profiles.notes: Doesn't explain itself. Suspicious of strangers. Would rather grunt than elaborate.

profiles.verbosity: complete sentences, subordinate clauses, no contractions
profiles.notes: Never drops a formal register, even under pressure; that restraint is the character.
